"import cadquery as cq

# ---- Hard-coded parameters (mm) ----
LENGTH = 100.0        # X extent of plate
WIDTH = 60.0          # Y extent of plate
THICKNESS = 8.0       # Z extent (base face at z = 0, thickness along +Z)
FILLET_RADIUS = 8.0   # fillet on all four vertical (Z-parallel) edges
HOLE_DIAMETER = 6.0   # through-hole diameter
HOLE_RADIUS = HOLE_DIAMETER / 2.0
HOLE_X = 35.0         # hole centers at (+/-35, +/-15)
HOLE_Y = 15.0

# ---- Plate: 100 (X) x 60 (Y) x 8 (Z), centered on origin in XY, base at z=0 ----
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(LENGTH, WIDTH, THICKNESS, centered=(True, True, False))

# ---- Fillet all four vertical (Z-parallel) edges with radius 8 ----
plate = plate.edges("|Z").fillet(FILLET_RADIUS)

# ---- Four through holes, diameter 6, axes parallel to Z, at (+/-35, +/-15) ----
hole_points = [
    ( HOLE_X,  HOLE_Y),
    (-HOLE_X,  HOLE_Y),
    ( HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
    (-HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
]

# Cutting cylinders overhang the plate in Z so the holes pass fully through the thickness
cutters = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, -1.0))
    .pushPoints(hole_points)
    .circle(HOLE_RADIUS)
    .extrude(THICKNESS + 2.0)
)

result = plate.cut(cutters)

solid = result.val()
assert solid.isValid(), "Resulting shape is not a valid B-Rep solid"
assert solid.Volume() > 0, "Resulting solid has non-positive volume"

# ---- Export the single solid to STEP in the current working directory ----
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")"
